side_effects.detail: Redis is not available locally, so the 3 real-Redis tests in tests/test_redis_cache.py (including the existing test_get_or_compute_caches_falsy_value) were SKIPPED; the falsy-value fix is verified only through a new in-memory fake-client test, not against a real Redis server.

summary: Fixed three kvcache bugs: (1) RedisCache.get_or_compute now treats only a missing key (raw None from Redis) as a miss, so falsy values like 0, '', [] and even null are cached; (2) LRUCache.get moves the key to the most-recent position so reads protect it from eviction; (3) serializers.dumps encodes datetime/date/time as ISO 8601 strings. Added a parametrized get_or_compute test using an in-memory fake client so it runs without Redis. Previously failing LRU and datetime/date tests now pass.
